history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all. I can't make calls, use the internet, or send picture messages. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s service issue. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for providing your information. To help resolve your "no service" issue, I’ll need to check a few things about your line and account status.

Can you please confirm if you see any icons or messages in your phone’s status bar (such as "No SIM", "Airplane Mode", or "No Signal")? If you’re not sure, I can guide you through checking this on your device. Would you like instructions on how to check your phone’s status bar?
I just checked the status bar. It says 'No Signal' and 'Data Disabled'. I’m also connected to WiFi (Chestnut-5G) and have a VPN on. What should I do next?

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no signal and cannot use calls, mobile data, or send picture messages. This is not related to your WiFi or VPN connection.

I’ll check if the suspension can be lifted and help you restore service. Would you like to proceed with resuming your line now?
Yes, please go ahead and resume my line so I can get my service back.

I’m unable to resume your line because its contract end date (November 30, 2024) is in the past. According to policy, I cannot lift the suspension in this situation.

If you need further assistance or want to discuss options for reactivating your service, I can transfer you to a human agent. Would you like me to do that?

tool_observations.error: Line LN-8830142 cannot be resumed because its contract end date (2024-11-30) is in the past.
